display.purpose: Day-count digit bank, login wordmark numerals, section titles.

body.purpose: Task labels and form content requiring sustained legibility.

shadows.name: flap-lip
shadows.purpose: Every flap card, in every state — the only elevated surface in the system.

motion.name: flap-flip
motion.value: spring(stiffness: 480, damping: 16) on rotateX from -100deg to 0, transform-origin top
motion.purpose: The signature interaction: a task flap dropping into its done state, with a small mechanical overshoot.

components.name: Flap (blank)
components.description: The base state of the signature flap primitive — an undone task, an unfilled water segment, a future day.
components.css: .ds-flap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #eee7d8; color: #1a1a18; border-radius: 5px; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25) inset, 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 5px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3); overflow: hidden; } .ds-flap::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 1px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.28); } .ds-flap--md { width: 44px; height: 44px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Flap (done)
components.description: A completed task or achieved day — the system's only 'positive' color.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call-to-action style — solid amber, no gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e8a33d; color: #241a08; border: 1px solid #e8a33d; border-radius: 9px; padding: 13px 16px; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a33d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Flap Row
components.description: A steel-plate task row with an icon chip, label, and a trailing Flap as the tap target.
components.css: .ds-flap-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: #242424; border: 1px solid #46494b; color: #eee7d8; width: 100%; } .ds-flap-row__icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #3a3d3f; border: 1px solid #46494b; } .ds-flap-row__label { flex: 1; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: A steel-recessed text input with a tracked uppercase label above it.
components.css: .ds-field__label { display: block; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #9c968a; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-field__input { padding: 12px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid #46494b; background: #2b2b2b; color: #eee7d8; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; caret-color: #e8a33d; } .ds-field__input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a33d; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: 75 Medium reads like the departure board at a gym or a train station: every day's status is a physical flap that flips into place, never a value that silently changes underneath you. That mechanism is not decoration — it is the honest expression of how the product actually works: challenge day, streak, and status are recomputed fresh from the log history on every load, so nothing here is a stored counter pretending to be a fact. The board flips because the truth flipped. The system replaces the incumbent look — a near-black gradient dashboard with glass cards, neon per-task colors, and gradient-clipped text — with a flat, mechanical, industrial world: charcoal board, ivory die-cut flap cards, brushed-steel chassis, one warm amber accent for "done," and brick red for "missed." Nothing glows, blurs, or gradates. Icons are drawn, not borrowed from emoji.
keyCharacteristics: Every stateful value renders as a physical flap card, not a colored badge or icon.
One accent color (amber) means 'done.' A second (brick) means 'missed.' Nothing else competes for that role.
Flat steel and board surfaces at rest; only flap cards carry a raised, mechanical drop-shadow.
Tabular numerals everywhere a count appears, so digits never jitter.
No gradients, no glass/blur, no neon, no emoji-as-icon, no leaderboard ranking of teammates.

rules.name: The One Flip Rule
rules.body: A value only ever has three visual states — blank (ivory), done (amber), or missed (brick). No fourth color is ever introduced for state.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Anywhere a number can change, font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums is mandatory so digits never shift the surrounding layout.

rules.name: The Flat-Chassis Rule
rules.body: Steel and board surfaces never cast a shadow of their own; only flap cards do.

dos: Do render every stateful value as a Flap, never as a colored badge, dot, or emoji.
Do keep amber exclusively for 'done' and brick exclusively for 'missed'.
Do apply tabular numerals to every numeric readout.
Do let a past day's row open already editable from wherever it's tapped.
Do keep teammates unranked and individually named on the Team screen.
donts: Don't use glass, blur, or a soft neon glow.
Don't use a Unicode emoji as a functional icon.
Don't introduce a fourth semantic state color.
Don't widen the app shell past 480px on large screens.
